question: Among 4%-up days that are also volume spikes (rvol50>=2), does higher delivery% (deliv_x20) confirm the move and grade better outcome? Expect higher delivery = better (VSA absorption/confirmation idea).
plain: Tests whether a 4% up-day volume spike is more reliable when backed by high delivery percentage, i.e. real buying rather than intraday churn (VSA absorption concept).
